expected_findings: Policy first incepted 15-Jun-2019; date of admission 03-Aug-2026 = 85+ months of continuous coverage (>60 months).
Clause 6.4 / IRDAI Moratorium: after 60 months, a claim cannot be contested for non-disclosure unless established fraud. Letter alleges no fraud.
Clause 6.1 itself is expressly 'subject to Clause 6.4'.
Letter cites only a vague 'Disclosure of Information clause' — no specific clause number (Clause 5.4 requires a specific clause).
Letter does not state Claims Review Committee approval (Clause 5.4; IRDAI Master Circular 2024).
Letter does not mention grievance / Ombudsman options.
Bonus: the claim is for a heart attack, not diabetes treatment; diabetes is a risk factor, not the treated condition.
Recoverable: full admissible bill within ₹5,00,000 SI.
Cataract (phacoemulsification + IOL) is listed as Day Care procedure DC-01 in Annexure I.
Clause 1.5 itself says the 24-hour limit does not apply to Day Care procedures; Clause 2.2 covers Day Care even under 24 hours.
Excl02 24-month waiting for cataract: first inception 01-Jan-2023 → 44 months before surgery, waiting period completed.
Insurer quoted Clause 1.5 selectively, ignoring its own exception.
Sub-limit check: cataract limit = lower of 25% SI (₹75,000) or ₹60,000 per eye = ₹60,000. Bill ₹48,500 is within limit → fully payable.
Excl01 in the policy wording states 36 months PED waiting, NOT 48 months as quoted in the letter.
IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024 cap PED waiting at 36 months.
First inception 10-Nov-2022 → admission 20-Sep-2026 = 46 months (>36 months). PED waiting completed.
PED was declared and accepted, so no non-disclosure issue.
Letter does not mention Ombudsman option.
Joint replacement + osteoarthritis are listed under Excl02 with 24-month waiting.
First inception 01-Mar-2026, surgery 18-Sep-2026 = ~6.5 months. Waiting NOT completed.
No accident (Excl02 accident exception doesn't apply). No portability credit.
Letter cites specific clause, mentions Claims Review Committee approval and grievance/Ombudsman options.
Correct output: honest 'rejection appears valid' + advice (keep policy renewed; claim payable after 01-Mar-2028).
